contracts_rationale: Internal migration-safety fix: no new API, CLI flag or payload schema. The doctor finding adds one code to an open finding set; the backfill-runtime-state --json residue key already exists (#6662).
friendly_name: Residue-safe migration sweep and fabricated-identity audit
purpose_context: After a branch switch, a kitty-specs folder can keep only untracked leftovers such as a stray work package file or status log. Upgrade migrations still treat such a folder as a Mission, write a baseline meta.json, mint a second identity for a real Mission's slug and auto-commit it. This Mission makes the residue decision git-aware, replaces the shipped 2.0.6 consistency sweep with a residue-aware successor without editing it, and adds a report-only doctor finding for identities fabricated by earlier upgrades (#6669, #6668).
purpose_tldr: Stop spec-kitty upgrade from fabricating a Mission identity into leftover kitty-specs folders, and report the identities earlier upgrades already fabricated.
